import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from collections import defaultdict

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Filter to expression and clinical features (exclude copy_number and derived)
    expr_clin_ids = [fid for fid, typ in zip(feats.ids, feats.types) 
                     if typ in ('expression', 'clinical')]
    
    # Compute effect sizes (mean difference in outcome groups)
    effect_sizes = []
    for fid in expr_clin_ids:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        x = feats.x[:, col_idx]
        y = feats.y
        mean_0 = np.mean(x[y == 0])
        mean_1 = np.mean(x[y == 1])
        effect_size = mean_1 - mean_0
        effect_sizes.append((fid, effect_size))
    
    # Sort by absolute effect size
    effect_sizes.sort(key=lambda x: abs(x[1]), reverse=True)
    
    # Select top candidates
    candidates = [fid for fid, _ in effect_sizes[:20]]
    
    # Identify correlated pairs with |r| >= 0.6
    corr_pairs = set()
    for i in range(len(candidates)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(candidates)):
            fid1, fid2 = candidates[i], candidates[j]
            col1 = feats.column(fid1)
            col2 = feats.column(fid2)
            r, _ = stats.pearsonr(feats.x[:, col1], feats.x[:, col2])
            if abs(r) >= 0.6:
                corr_pairs.add((min(fid1, fid2), max(fid1, fid2)))
    
    # Build clusters of correlated features
    clusters = []
    used = set()
    for fid1, fid2 in corr_pairs:
        if fid1 in used or fid2 in used:
            continue
        cluster = {fid1, fid2}
        used.update(cluster)
        # Expand cluster
        changed = True
        while changed:
            changed = False
            for fid1_, fid2_ in corr_pairs:
                if fid1_ in cluster or fid2_ in cluster:
                    new_cluster = cluster | {fid1_, fid2_}
                    if len(new_cluster) > len(cluster):
                        cluster = new_cluster
                        changed = True
        clusters.append(list(cluster))
    
    # Find dominant features in each cluster
    drivers = []
    for cluster in clusters:
        # Score each feature in cluster by effect size
        scores = [(fid, abs(effect_sizes[expr_clin_ids.index(fid)][1])) 
                  for fid in cluster if fid in expr_clin_ids]
        scores.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
        if scores:
            dominant_fid = scores[0][0]
            drivers.append(dominant_fid)
    
    # Add uncorrelated top features
    uncorrelated = [fid for fid in expr_clin_ids if not any(fid in c for c in clusters)]
    uncorrelated.sort(key=lambda fid: abs(effect_sizes[expr_clin_ids.index(fid)][1]), reverse=True)
    drivers.extend(uncorrelated[:max(0, MAX_DRIVERS - len(drivers))])
    
    # Remove duplicates and limit to MAX_DRIVERS
    drivers = list(dict.fromkeys(drivers))[:MAX_DRIVERS]
    
    # Build columns and products
    columns = list(drivers)
    
    # Add products between drivers
    products = []
    for i in range(len(drivers)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(drivers)):
            products.append((drivers[i], drivers[j]))
    
    # Build loadings (weighted sum of drivers)
    loadings = {}
    for fid in drivers:
        idx = expr_clin_ids.index(fid)
        loadings[fid] = effect_sizes[idx][1]
    
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple(drivers),
        columns=tuple(columns),
        products=tuple(products),
        loadings=loadings
    )
